summary.en: Most English sentences follow Subject + Verb + Object order. This order keeps the meaning clear. Time and place usually come after the object.
summary.fa: بیشتر جملات انگلیسی ترتیب فاعل + فعل + مفعول دارند. این ترتیب معنی را واضح می‌کند. زمان و مکان معمولاً بعد از مفعول می‌آیند.

en: Start with the subject (My sister plays football).
Put the main verb after the subject (She reads books).
Place the object after the verb (They watch TV).
Put time expressions at the end (I study at night).
Place expressions often follow time (We meet on Monday at school).
Use S + V when there is no object (He sleeps).
fa: جمله را با فاعل شروع کنید (My sister plays football).
فعل اصلی بعد از فاعل می‌آید (She reads books).
مفعول بعد از فعل می‌آید (They watch TV).
زمان در پایان می‌آید (I study at night).
مکان معمولاً بعد از زمان می‌آید (We meet on Monday at school).
اگر مفعول ندارید، فقط فاعل + فعل کافی است (He sleeps).

en: I read a book. (SVO)
Tom eats lunch at noon. (time at end)
We play soccer in the park. (place)
She opens the window. (SVO)
They watch a movie tonight. (time)
My friends visit me on Friday. (time)
The dog chased the ball. (SVO)
Anna works in a hospital. (place)

summary.en: Statements give information, negatives say something is not true, and questions ask for information. You can build all three using simple patterns.
summary.fa: جملات خبری اطلاعات می‌دهند، منفی‌ها عدم درست بودن را نشان می‌دهند و سوال‌ها اطلاعات می‌خواهند. هر سه با الگوهای ساده ساخته می‌شوند.

en: Statements use S + V (He works).
Negatives use do/does + not (She does not drive).
Use don't/doesn't in speech (I don't know).
Be-verb negatives place not after be (He is not late).
Yes/No questions start with Do/Does/Is/Are (Do you like it?).
Wh- questions start with a question word (Where do you live?).
fa: جمله خبری با فاعل + فعل می‌آید (He works).
جمله منفی با do/does + not ساخته می‌شود (She does not drive).
در گفتار از don't/doesn't استفاده کنید (I don't know).
در جملات be، not بعد از be می‌آید (He is not late).
سوال بله/خیر با Do/Does/Is/Are شروع می‌شود (Do you like it?).
سوال Wh- با کلمه سوال شروع می‌شود (Where do you live?).

Is it cold outside? (be question)

summary.en: Present simple talks about habits and facts. Present continuous talks about actions happening now or temporary situations. Choosing the right tense makes your meaning clear.
summary.fa: حال ساده برای عادت‌ها و حقیقت‌هاست. حال استمراری برای کارهای در حال انجام یا وضعیت موقت است. انتخاب درست زمان، معنی را واضح می‌کند.

en: Use present simple for routines (I go to work every day).
Use present simple for facts (Water boils at 100°C).
Use present continuous for actions now (She is studying now).
Use present continuous for temporary situations (He is living in Tehran this month).
Simple uses base verb or -s (He plays soccer).
Continuous uses am/is/are + ing (They are playing now).
Use time words to choose tense (usually = simple).
fa: حال ساده برای عادت است (I go to work every day).
حال ساده برای حقیقت است (Water boils at 100°C).
حال استمراری برای کارِ الان است (She is studying now).
حال استمراری برای وضعیت موقت است (He is living in Tehran this month).
در حال ساده فعل پایه یا -s می‌آید (He plays soccer).
در حال استمراری از am/is/are + ing استفاده می‌شود (They are playing now).
از کلمات زمان کمک بگیرید (usually = حال ساده).

en: I read books every night. (habit)
She works at a bank. (fact)
They are watching TV now. (now)

We play football on Fridays. (routine)
I am staying with my aunt this week. (temporary)
The sun rises in the east. (fact)
She is talking on the phone. (action now)

en.explanation: Use present simple for routines, not continuous.
Use present continuous for actions happening now.
Stative verbs like know are not used in continuous.

summary.en: Past continuous describes actions in progress at a specific time in the past. It is also used for background actions. It helps show what was happening.
summary.fa: گذشته استمراری کار در حال انجام در یک زمان مشخص گذشته را نشان می‌دهد. برای بیان عمل زمینه هم استفاده می‌شود. این زمان نشان می‌دهد چه چیزی در حال وقوع بوده است.

en: Form: was/were + verb-ing (I was studying).
Use was with I/he/she/it (She was cooking).
Use were with you/we/they (They were playing).
Use for an action at a past time (At 8, I was sleeping).
Use for background action (I was reading when he arrived).
Negatives: wasn't/weren't + ing (We weren't working).
fa: ساختار: was/were + ing (I was studying).
برای I/he/she/it از was استفاده کنید (She was cooking).
برای you/we/they از were استفاده کنید (They were playing).
برای زمان مشخص گذشته استفاده کنید (At 8, I was sleeping).
برای عمل زمینه استفاده کنید (I was reading when he arrived).
منفی: wasn't/weren't + ing (We weren't working).

They were playing in the yard. (background)
We were watching a movie. (in progress)

The kids were sleeping. (background)
I was reading when you called. (background)
It was raining all evening. (situation)

بچه‌ها خواب بودند. (زمینه)

تمام عصر باران می‌بارید. (وضعیت)

fa.explanation: گذشته استمراری به ing نیاز دارد.
با she باید was بیاید.
با they باید were بیاید.

summary.en: Past simple describes finished actions. Past continuous describes an action in progress. We often use them together to show a shorter action interrupting a longer one.
summary.fa: گذشته ساده عمل تمام‌شده را نشان می‌دهد. گذشته استمراری عمل در جریان را نشان می‌دهد. معمولاً برای قطع شدن یک عمل بلند با یک عمل کوتاه از هر دو استفاده می‌کنیم.

en: Use past simple for completed actions (I finished my homework).
Use past continuous for ongoing actions (I was studying).
Combine them with when (I was reading when he called).
Past continuous gives background (She was cooking).
Past simple shows the interrupting action (The phone rang).
Use time words like while/when (While I was walking, it started to rain).
fa: گذشته ساده برای عمل تمام‌شده است (I finished my homework).
گذشته استمراری برای عمل در جریان است (I was studying).
با when هر دو را ترکیب کنید (I was reading when he called).
گذشته استمراری عمل زمینه است (She was cooking).
گذشته ساده عمل کوتاه و قطع‌کننده است (The phone rang).
از while/when برای زمان استفاده کنید (While I was walking, it started to rain).

en: I was reading when the door opened. (interrupt)
She was cooking when the lights went out. (interrupt)

He was studying all evening. (ongoing)
I called you last night. (completed)
She was sleeping at 10 PM. (ongoing)
fa: وقتی در باز شد من داشتم کتاب می‌خواندم. (قطع شدن)
وقتی چراغ‌ها خاموش شد او داشت آشپزی می‌کرد. (قطع شدن)
وقتی او رسید ما داشتیم تلویزیون می‌دیدیم. (قطع شدن)
وقتی داشتم راه می‌رفتم یک گربه دیدم. (while)
آنها دیروز فوتبال بازی کردند. (تمام‌شده)
او تمام عصر درس می‌خواند. (در جریان)
دیشب به تو زنگ زدم. (تمام‌شده)
ساعت ۱۰ او خواب بود. (در جریان)

summary.en: Use the past continuous (was/were + verb-ing) for actions in progress at a specific time in the past, often interrupted by past simple.

en: Form: was/were + verb-ing (I was working).
Negative: wasn't/weren't + verb-ing (They weren't listening).
Question: Was/Were + subject + verb-ing? (Were you sleeping?).
Use with 'at 7 pm', 'while', 'when' to show background action.
Interrupted action: past continuous + when + past simple (I was cooking when he called).
Two long actions: past continuous + while + past continuous (She was studying while I was working).

summary.en: Passive voice focuses on the receiver of the action. Form is be + past participle; the agent is optional (by...).
summary.fa: Passive voice focuses on the receiver of the action. Form is be + past participle; the agent is optional (by...).

en: Present simple passive: am/is/are + V3 (The room is cleaned).
Past simple passive: was/were + V3 (The room was cleaned).
Use when the doer is unknown/unimportant (My bike was stolen).
Use 'by' to add the doer (It was made by Anna).
Keep the tense in 'be' (is/was/will be).
Objects become subjects in passive (They built a bridge → A bridge was built).
